definition: In mental health, detoxification is a structured period following chronic alcohol use that is intended to support short-term recovery from alcohol-related effects on the body. In this context, it refers to recovery after alcohol has contributed to problems such as cardiovascular instability, blood changes, and oxidative stress imbalance.
